title: Ulta Beauty: Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Ulta value thesis and layered Bitcoin trust.
coverage_note: Read complete including macro, quoted carry interview, Fedi, Bit VM, Ulta fundamentals/risks and gold. Current technical documents may be revised since 2024.

evidence.title: 2024 central-bank gold survey
evidence.finding: Central banks added 1,037 tonnes in 2023 after 1,082 tonnes in 2022. Survey of 70 respondents conducted February-April 2024: 29% planned higher own gold reserves. Motives included strategic rebalancing, domestic production, crisis and inflation risk; survey intentions are not completed purchases.

framework_lessons: Value needs business and price tests.
assessment: The eighteen-month bitcoin direction resolved positively, while the Ulta recommendation has strong disclosed cutoff performance and only partial business-mechanism support. Carry-market analysis was supported by BIS. Technical exposition usefully separates custodial designs but overstates Fedi launch licensing and compresses Bit VM security assumptions. The source discloses a direct investment interest in Fedi; that warrants independent checks, not automatic dismissal.
verification_limitations: Current snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date vintage.
Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
